about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • Unique weapon “Ion cyclotron discharger”

  • Unique active module “Guided meta-field generator”

  • Unique engine modifier “Drift Synchronizer”

  • Unique capacitor modifier “Superconducting commutator”

  • 60 monocrystals

  • A set of resources with 50 ores each: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards

  • Pattern “Copper dawn”

  • Animated decor “Quetzal”

  • Unique portrait “Red silence”

  • Unique title “Witcher”

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 15 days!
